source_answer.text: Family Health Optima Insurance Plan: Road ambulance expenses are covered up to INR 750 per hospitalization and INR 1,500 per Policy Period, subject to an admissible hospitalization claim. Covered transport is by private ambulance to hospital when medically needed, between hospitals for improved medical treatment, or from the treating hospital to the insured person’s residence in the same city when certified by the medical practitioner. A hospitalization claim must be admissible. Travel home must be within the same city and the ambulance requirement must be medically certified.

source_answer.text: Star Comprehensive Insurance Policy: Road ambulance expenses are payable, subject to an admissible hospitalization claim, for medically needed private-ambulance transport to a hospital; private-ambulance transfer between hospitals for improved medical treatment; or transport from the treating hospital to the insured person’s residence in the same city when ambulance transport home is certified by the medical practitioner. The hospitalization claim must be admissible. Transport to a hospital must be by private ambulance and medically needed. Transfer between hospitals must be by private ambulance for improved medical treatment. Transport home must be from the treating hospital, the residence must be in the same city, and the medical practitioner must certify the need for an ambulance to the residence.

source_answer.text: Star Health Assure Insurance Policy: Road ambulance expenses are covered at actuals, forming part of the Sum Insured, subject to an admissible hospitalization claim. Covered transport is by private ambulance to a hospital when medically needed, between hospitals for improved medical treatment, or from the treating hospital to the residence when it is in the same city and ambulance need is medically certified. An admissible hospitalization claim is required. Transport to hospital must be by private ambulance and needed for medical reasons. Inter-hospital transport must be by private ambulance for improved medical treatment. Transport home is limited to the same city and requires certification by the medical practitioner that an ambulance is required. The benefit forms part of the Sum Insured.

Star Health Assure Insurance Policy: In-patient hospitalization expenses for organ transplantation from the donor to the insured recipient are payable when the transplantation claim is payable. Donor expenses for complications requiring redo surgery or ICU admission are also covered. Organ-donor expenses form part of the Sum Insured; the additional amount for those donor complications is above the Limit of Coverage, up to the Sum Insured, and may be used only by the donor. Transplants and related surgeries have a specified-procedure waiting period. The transplantation claim must be payable. The additional amount applies to donor complications requiring redo surgery or ICU admission and may be used only by the donor. All transplant types and related surgeries are excluded until 24 months of continuous coverage have expired; this waiting-period exclusion does not apply to accident claims.

Star Health Assure Insurance Policy: The base policy covers non-medical items (consumables) specified in List I when there is an admissible inpatient or day-care claim. List I includes items such as ambulance, gloves and oxygen mask. Items assigned to Lists II, III and IV are to be subsumed into room charges, procedure charges or treatment costs, respectively, rather than treated as separately payable consumables. A claim must be admissible under inpatient or day-care coverage, and only items specified in List I become payable. Lists II, III and IV identify items subsumed into the corresponding room, procedure or treatment costs.
